product.title: 90 min Electric Bike Tour of Fort Lauderdale (min 2)
product.description: See more of the city without navigating a new area alone with this guided electric bicycle tour of the greater Fort Lauderdale area. Meet your guide at Colee Hammock Park, then ride to landmarks like Riverwalk Fort Lauderdale and Las Olas Boulevard while passing the beach and historic neighborhoods.
highlights: Spot mega yachts and million-dollar houses along the Intracoastal
Ride to Riverwalk Fort Lauderdale, Las Olas Boulevard, and nearby beaches
No prior e-bike experience needed with a safety tutorial before departure
Light refreshments are available from your guide
inclusions: Electric bike with easy step-thru setup
Full instruction, tutorial, and tour briefing

meetingPoint.description: Colee Hammock Park, 1500 Brickell Dr, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33301, USA. Please confirm your start time 24 hours in advance.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking
This tour/activity will have a maximum of 8 travelers

faqs.question: Where is the meeting point?
faqs.answer: The suggested meeting point is Colee Hammock Park in Fort Lauderdale. Confirm your exact start details with the operator in advance.

faqs.question: Do I need e-bike experience?
faqs.answer: No prior experience is required. The tour includes a tutorial and safety briefing before departure.
